CTI-Bench: Attack Technique Extraction (ATE)
	


	
		
		Dataset Description
	

This dataset contains 60 examples for extracting MITRE Enterprise attack technique IDs from malware and attack descriptions. It tests a model's ability to map cybersecurity descriptions to specific MITRE ATT&CK techniques.

	
		
		Dataset Structure
	

Each example contains:

platform: Target platform (Enterprise, Mobile, etc.)
